items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Huawei has officially launched its new Mate 90 series in China, introducing several flagship smartphones with upgrades in performance, display technology, cameras, durability, and artificial intelligence.
The lineup includes the HUAWEI Mate 90, Mate 90 Pro, Mate 90 Pro Max, and Mate 90 RS ULTIMATE DESIGN. Huawei has equipped the series with its latest Kirin chipsets, while the top-end models also feature the new LogicFolding Tau architecture.
Huawei Mate 90 Series is Now Official – Check out Key Specs, Design, Availability and Pricing Here
According to Huawei, the new series reflects years of investment in its own hardware, software, and chip technologies. The company said it invested CNY1.8 trillion in research and development between 2007 and the end of 2025.
New Kirin Chips Power the Series
The Mate 90 Pro Max and higher-end models use the Kirin 9050 Pro chipset. Huawei claims the chip delivers a 31% improvement in overall performance.
The Mate 90 Pro uses the Kirin 9035, which is claimed to offer a 20% performance increase, while the standard Mate 90 comes with the Kirin 9030 and offers a reported 27% performance gain.
Huawei has also focused on gaming performance. The Kirin 9050 Pro supports hardware-accelerated ray tracing and can reportedly process up to 55 million rays per second.
The chips work alongside HarmonyOS 7 as part of Huawei’s integrated hardware and software approach.
Display Reaches 12,000 Nits
The Mate 90 Pro introduces Huawei’s second-generation Linglong Display. The panel can reach a peak brightness of 12,000 nits at 1% APL and uses an improved Tandem OLED architecture.
Huawei says the new panel architecture increases display lifespan by 138%.
The Mate 90 Pro Max and Mate 90 RS ULTIMATE DESIGN take things further with Full-color Linglong Displays and BT.2020 color management. More than 60 popular apps can reportedly convert P3 content into a wider BT.2020 color range.
Huawei has also added new eye-care features, including ambient-light detection and a 1-nit low-brightness mode.
Major Camera Upgrades
Camera performance is another major focus of the Mate 90 series. All models feature True-to-Color Camera 3.0, which uses a full-focal-length infrared optical coating to improve color reproduction.
Huawei claims the technology improves overall color accuracy by 37% and skin-tone accuracy by 62%.
The Mate 90 Pro Max gets the most advanced camera setup in the lineup. It features an 18 EV ultra-HDR main camera and a 200MP RYYB telephoto camera. The phone also uses hardware-based image stabilization rated at 7.5 by CIPA.
Huawei says the system can produce stable images at zoom levels above 20x.
The company has also introduced the XMAGE Z10 Modular Camera with a 1-inch sensor and continuous optical zoom covering 24mm to 240mm. The camera has a maximum aperture range of f/2.0 to f/4.5.
See Also: Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max launches with 12,000-nit display and 200MP periscope camera
Stronger Build and Water Resistance
The Mate 90 Pro and higher-end models use Huawei’s full-body Kunlun Xuanwu architecture for additional durability.
The camera cover uses Optical Kunlun Glass, which Huawei says offers 20 times better drop resistance. The front display uses third-generation Kunlun Glass with a claimed 50% improvement in impact resistance.
The Pro Max Premium Edition and RS ULTIMATE DESIGN use upgraded Xuanwu Kunlun Glass, with Huawei claiming reduced reflections and improved scratch resistance.
The entire lineup carries IP68 dust and water resistance up to six meters, along with IP69 protection against high-temperature and high-pressure water jets.
Connectivity and AI Features
Huawei has also upgraded connectivity across the Mate 90 family. The phones feature a new combined Wi-Fi and cellular antenna design that provides a reported 2dB increase in signal gain.
All models support eSIM, while the Mate 90 Pro Max supports four SIMs with three active standby connections.
The phones also include HarmonyOS AI features. On the Pro Max and higher models, Huawei uses a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model for on-device AI functions.
Features include Celia Memories for organizing content, context-aware suggestions through the Celia navigation bar, automated call answering, call summaries and real-time translation.
Celia Gallery Assistant can also help users edit photos through voice or text commands and generate videos.
Mate 90 RS ULTIMATE DESIGN
The Mate 90 RS ULTIMATE DESIGN sits at the top of the lineup. It features a redesigned Star Diamond camera module and Dynamic Lenticular Kunlun Glass.
The phone is available with an Ascending Texture finish in Red, White, and Black. It includes the Kirin 9050 Pro, Full-color Linglong Display, satellite communication features, and the advanced camera system found on the Pro Max.
Huawei Mate 90 Series Prices
The Huawei Mate 90 series starts at CNY 5,999 in China. The announced prices are:
Huawei Mate 90: CNY5,999
Huawei Mate 90 Pro: CNY6,999
Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max: CNY9,499
Huawei Mate 90 RS ULTIMATE DESIGN: CNY12,999
Huawei has positioned the Mate 90 series as a major showcase for its latest Kirin processors, HarmonyOS software, display technology, and XMAGE camera system. The company has not provided details in the supplied announcement about international availability or pricing.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
WhatsApp is rolling out a new Restricted Chat feature to some Android beta testers. The feature is designed to give users more control over sensitive conversations by adding extra restrictions to specific chats.
Restricted Chat replaces the Advanced Chat Privacy feature. WhatsApp is also changing how the feature works by preventing restricted conversations from being accessed through linked devices.
The new feature is available to some users running WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.39.11. The rollout is gradual, so it may take some time before it reaches more beta testers.
Restricted Chat Adds Extra Privacy Controls
WhatsApp already protects messages and calls with end-to-end encryption. The new Restricted Chat option is an additional layer of control rather than a requirement for secure conversations.
The company previously tested the feature under the Advanced Chat Privacy name. However, the name could make some users believe that their conversations were not secure without the feature. The new Restricted Chat name makes it clearer that the option provides additional restrictions for selected conversations.
Users can enable Restricted Chat from the chat information screen. The option is turned off by default and must be activated manually.
For now, the feature is available only for individual chats.
What Happens When a Chat Is Restricted?
Once Restricted Chat is enabled, WhatsApp applies several limitations to the conversation. Media received in the restricted chat will not be automatically saved to the device’s gallery.
Users also cannot export the conversation. In addition, Meta AI features cannot be used inside a restricted chat.
The biggest change in the latest update is that restricted conversations cannot be accessed through linked devices.
WhatsApp displays a system message in the conversation after the feature is enabled. The message informs participants that messages can only be sent and received on their primary devices.
Linked Devices Are No Longer Supported
The linked-device restriction is one of the main changes introduced with Restricted Chat.
Previously, conversations protected by Advanced Chat Privacy could still be accessed through linked devices. The new feature removes this option for restricted conversations.
This change could also make it harder for unofficial clients and certain AI-based tools to access messages through linked devices. By blocking linked-device access for a specific conversation, WhatsApp adds another barrier against third-party tools that depend on those connections.
The restriction applies to everyone in the conversation, meaning participants cannot use linked devices to access that particular chat once it has been restricted.
See Also: WhatsApp Adds New Parental Controls For Teen Accounts and Meta AI
Gradual Rollout for Android Beta Users
WhatsApp is currently making Restricted Chat available to a limited number of Android beta testers. More users are expected to receive the feature in the coming weeks.
Those who still see Advanced Chat Privacy instead of Restricted Chat may simply have to wait for the feature to reach their accounts.
WhatsApp has not yet confirmed when Restricted Chat will be released for all Android users through the stable version of the app. The company is expected to gather feedback from beta testers before expanding the feature further.

items.author: Rizwana Omer
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Fake ChatGPT ads on Google sent Windows users toward a malware trap that began with an ordinary search. Security researchers at Island say the campaign ran for about three months and ended in a fake verification page that told people to run a command on their own computers.
The ads were not hard to find. They appeared for searches such as “ChatGPT”, according to Island.
How the trap worked
The attackers did not build a fake website from scratch. Island says they created their own content using ChatGPT’s Custom GPT feature, then bought Google ads that led to it. Custom GPTs are user-built assistants that anyone can publish and share.
According to Island, the ads led to genuine chatgpt.com pages that carried attacker-written content. That detail matters. Checking the web address at this first step would have shown the real ChatGPT domain.
The trap opened only after a user typed a prompt. Instead of an answer, the person was shown a message about “high traffic” and pointed to a “backup domain”.
Where the verification page comes in
The backup domain led to a counterfeit ChatGPT and Cloudflare verification page. It told users to press Win+R, paste text from the clipboard and press Enter, supposedly to prove they were human.
Researchers call this technique “ClickFix”. The victim, not the attacker, runs the malicious command, so the person ends up doing the attacker’s work. The pasted command quietly downloads disguised malware.
Island’s analysis found behaviour consistent with NetSupport RAT, a remote-access tool that lets an attacker control a computer as if sitting at the keyboard. Reports on the research add that the malware can survive restarts and send data to attackers through a Telegram bot.
The campaign by the numbers
Island mapped the activity from late May through August 24, 2026.
Measure
Figure
Paid-ad landings
About 850
Lookalike ChatGPT destinations
26
Google Ads campaign IDs
71
Period covered
Late May to August 24, 2026
The data has a limit. Island’s research shows the scale of the ad activity but not how many users were infected.
Researchers also saw the attackers rotate domains and use other Windows delivery routes. That suggests the operation did not depend on one disposable site.
A similar campaign from another firm
A separate report from security firm Huntress describes a related campaign. It found a Custom GPT called “Plus 5.6” designed to pass as an upgraded ChatGPT model, promoted through sponsored search results.
Huntress traced at least 40 incidents to the Google Sites page used as the bridge. It confirmed that only two began directly from the Custom GPT, so 40 should not be read as the number of Custom GPT infections. It also reported that a replacement lure appeared after the first one was removed.
The two reports describe similar methods, and I found nothing in the sources confirming they are the same operation.
How to protect yourself
Researchers point to one clear red flag. No genuine CAPTCHA or verification page should ask you to open Windows Run, paste a command or use PowerShell.
Other habits help:
Open ChatGPT by typing the address or using a bookmark, not through a sponsored result.
Treat a “backup domain” message as a warning sign.
If you already ran such a command, disconnect from the internet, run a security scan and change important passwords from a different, clean device. Tell your IT team if it is a work machine.
The campaign did not exploit a software flaw. It relied on three trusted things at once: a search ad, a real ChatGPT address and a familiar verification screen.
That pushes the safety advice away from “check the link” and toward “check the request”. A real domain can still host a harmful page, so the better test is what the page asks you to do. The sources I reviewed do not include a response from Google or OpenAI, and the underlying problem of how easily people can publish and promote look-alike pages remains open.

items.content:
Acer Indonesia memperluas strategi di pasar gaming melalui program #5TahunSiapTempur atau Predator 5 Years Protection, sekaligus kembali menggelar kompetisi menuju Asia Pacific Predator League 2027. Program ini tidak hanya berfokus pada perangkat, tetapi juga mencakup dukungan layanan purnajual serta kesempatan bagi gamer dan kreator untuk berkompetisi.
Melalui Predator 5 Years Protection, pengguna laptop dan desktop Predator Gaming yang dibeli pada periode 1 Oktober hingga 31 Desember 2026 mendapatkan sejumlah layanan tambahan. Paket tersebut mencakup satu tahun Acer Accidental Damage Protection, tiga tahun garansi layanan dan suku cadang, serta Predator Service Spa hingga lima tahun.

Kompetisi ini mempertandingkan VALORANT, League of Legends, EA Sports FC 27, dan Tekken 8. Acer juga membuka jalur bagi kreator melalui Predator Creator’s Legacy.
Baca Juga: Acer Nitro V15, Menawarkan Pengalaman Laptop Gaming yang All-Round
Perlindungan Perangkat Diperpanjang hingga Lima Tahun
Program #5TahunSiapTempur atau Predator 5 Years Protection memberikan perlindungan yang lebih panjang dibandingkan layanan standar pada umumnya, tetapi cakupannya terbagi berdasarkan jenis layanan. Selain perlindungan kerusakan tidak disengaja selama satu tahun, pengguna mendapatkan tiga tahun garansi service, spare part, dan on-site service.
Sementara itu, selain dari Predator 5 Years Protection, ada juga Predator Service Spa berlangsung hingga lima tahun dan mencakup cleaning, pemeriksaan kondisi perangkat, diagnosis, pembaruan BIOS atau firmware, serta potongan harga hingga 25 persen untuk pembelian spare part. Layanan tersebut tersedia di 18 Acer Customer Service Center di Indonesia. Program berlaku otomatis sejak pembelian dan tidak membutuhkan registrasi tambahan.
Bersamaan dengan program tersebut, Acer menawarkan Champion’s Deal selama periode yang sama. Konsumen dapat memperoleh opsi cicilan 0 persen mulai Rp1,8 juta per bulan serta bonus tertentu pada sejumlah produk Predator. Namun, jenis bonus tetap bergantung pada produk dan ketentuan promo yang berlaku.
Kompetisi Predator League Kembali Digelar
Dari sisi ekosistem esports, Road to Asia Pacific Predator League 2027 menjadi jalur kompetisi bagi gamer Indonesia menuju ajang regional di Vietnam pada Januari 2027. Pemenang kategori VALORANT dan League of Legends akan memperoleh kesempatan mewakili Indonesia di panggung tersebut, yang memiliki total prize pool US$400 ribu.
Sementara itu, Predator Creator’s Legacy memperluas cakupan kompetisi ke kreator, streamer, gamer, influencer, dan mahasiswa. Program ini menggunakan format live streaming competition serta social media challenge dan berlangsung hingga 22 November 2026.
Tiga kreator terbaik akan mendapatkan hadiah serta kesempatan melakukan perjalanan ke Final Asia Pacific Predator League 2027 di Vietnam. Dengan kombinasi layanan perangkat dan kompetisi, Acer pada akhirnya mencoba memperluas ekosistem Predator, bukan hanya dari sisi hardware gaming, tetapi juga dukungan setelah pembelian dan ruang bagi talenta untuk berkembang.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
Harga barang elektronik, termasuk harga HP naik diprediksi akan terus meningkat karena semakin mahalnya komponen memori. Qualcom menyebut, persoalan yang sedang dihadapi industri saat ini bukan kelangkaan chipset Snapdragon. Akan tetapi, semakin sedikit pasokan memori di pasaran karena banyak diserap untuk kebutuhan data center.
Hal tersebut disampaikan oleh Don McGuire, selaku EVP dan Chief Marketing Officer, Qualcomm Incorporated dan ST Liew, Vice President, Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and President, Qualcomm Southeast Asia, Australia and New Zealand.
Dalam sesi wawancara bersama media saat Snapdragon Partners & Media Event Indonesia 2026 di Jakarta, Kamis (1/10/2026). Keduanya menjelaskan, kondisi memori saat ini bisa ikut mendorong harga HP naik serta kapan perusahaan memperkirakan tekanan tersebut mulai mereda.
Bukan Snapdragon yang Jadi Masalah
Snapdragon Partners & Media Event Indonesia 2026 di Jakarta. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Qualcomm menegaskan, pasokan chipset Snapdragon bukan persoalan utama sedang dihadapi industri. Menurut perusahaan, tantangan justru berada pada memori yang berada di luar komponen prosesor Snapdragon.
“Kami tidak memiliki masalah pasokan cip, sehingga kami dapat menyediakan cip Snapdragon bagi pelanggan kami dalam jumlah berapa pun yang mereka inginkan,” jawab Don.
Qualcomm menjelaskan, persoalan berikutnya adalah apakah perusahaan dapat memperoleh memori dari pemasok lain. Kondisi tersebut membuat ketersediaan komponen sangat bergantung pada strategi masing-masing produsen smartphone.
Beberapa OEM disebut memiliki divisi yang memproduksi memori, sementara produsen lain membeli komponen tersebut dari pasar terbuka. Karena itu, kondisi pasokan dapat berbeda antara satu OEM dan OEM lainnya.
“Kami tidak akan menjadi hambatan dalam rantai pasok,” jawabnya. Dengan kata lain, Qualcomm menilai chipset Snapdragon bukan titik membatasi produksi smartphone saat ini. Tekanan berakibat harga HP naik justru berada pada komponen memori.
Mengapa Harga HP Naik?
Qualcomm membedakan kenaikan harga perangkat yang muncul akibat inovasi dengan harga HP naik dipicu lonjakan biaya memori. Dalam kondisi normal, smartphone generasi baru bisa mengalami kenaikan harga karena membawa kamera yang lebih baik, kemampuan baru, baterai lebih besar, atau material berbeda.
Menurut Qualcomm, kondisi tersebut merupakan bagian dari siklus produk yang biasa terjadi. Namun, lonjakan harga memori menciptakan situasi yang berbeda.
Dom mengatakan, “penyebab ketidaknormalan tersebut adalah harga memori.” Qualcomm menjelaskan, ketika harga memori meningkat jauh di atas kondisi normal, komponen tersebut dapat mengambil porsi biaya smartphone yang jauh lebih besar.
“Karena memori harganya 10 kali lebih mahal, dan kini porsinya terhadap harga HP naik pun lebih besar.” Pernyataan tersebut digunakan Qualcomm untuk menggambarkan bagaimana kenaikan biaya memori dapat memberikan tekanan yang lebih besar terhadap harga perangkat dibanding kenaikan harga yang biasanya muncul karena inovasi.
Qualcomm Siapkan Teknologi untuk Kurangi Beban Memori
Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 dan Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 diperkenalkan pada Snapdragon Summit 2026. (Doc: Qualcomm)
Qualcomm sendiri mengatakan, mereka sedang mengembangkan pendekatan yang dapat membuat penggunaan memori lebih efisien. Dalam transkrip, teknologi tersebut disebut sebagai HPC.
“Kami berupaya melakukan inovasi pada teknologi memori agar masalah ini tidak menjadi masalah jangka panjang, melainkan hanya masalah jangka pendek bagi pelanggan kami,” jelas Dom.
Menurut Qualcomm, pendekatan tersebut diharapkan mulai hadir pada sejumlah perangkat pelanggan pada 2027. Tujuannya adalah membantu OEM mengelola kebutuhan memori secara lebih efisien dan mencegah harga HP naik.
Qualcomm juga menyebut persoalan memori diharapkan tidak lagi menjadi masalah besar pada akhir 2027 atau awal 2028. “Kami memperkirakan bahwa masalah memori tidak akan lagi menjadi kendala pada akhir tahun 2027 atau awal tahun 2028,” katanya.
Belum Bisa Memastikan Harga HP Akan Turun
Ilustrasi sentra toko smartphone ITC Roxy Mas di Jakarta (Foto: Bambang/Gizmologi)
Meski memperkirakan persoalan memori akan membaik dalam beberapa tahun mendatang, Qualcomm tidak memberikan kepastian mengenai arah harga smartphone.
“I cannot predict whether prices will continue to go up. We hope not, but I cannot predict that,” ucap Don
Qualcomm mengatakan perusahaan masih melihat permintaan tinggi terhadap AI agentic. Karena itu, perkembangan kebutuhan komputasi dan memori masih menjadi faktor yang perlu diperhatikan.
Bagi konsumen, kondisi ini berarti kenaikan harga smartphone tidak semata-mata berkaitan dengan prosesor yang digunakan. Harga memori, kebutuhan data center, inovasi perangkat, serta strategi pengadaan setiap OEM juga dapat memengaruhi biaya akhir sebuah smartphone.

items.author: Team Inc42
items.content:
OpenAI Dispute Sparks Academic Panic
Last month, OpenAI’s Codex possibly solved the Navier-Stokes equations in days. But mathematician Tristan Buckmaster feared that his unpublished drafts had fed the model. So, why has the episode sparked concerns related to credit and ownership in the AI era?
The Buckmaster Saga: At the center of the dispute are the century-old equations, which carry a $1 Mn prize. After Buckmaster uploaded his unpublished research into the unreleased model, the AI giant announced that it had solved a key proof in four days. Though OpenAI denied using user inputs for that specific output, the episode exposed how feeding confidential academic work into AI tools could erode priority and career-defining credit.
India’s AI Rulebook: Amid the row, Indian academia is moving from instinct to policy. Many local researchers use AI only for literature review, but avoid uploading complete solutions or patentable methods. Institutes are also running smaller open-weight models on campus servers, discouraging frontier models for sensitive data, citing lack of user control.
Many colleges are also framing guidelines for responsible AI use, including secure handling of unpublished research.
The Policy Gap: India does not have a standalone law that governs AI in research. Even DPIIT’s proposed 2025 framework focuses primarily on financial compensation. Legal experts argue that this fits creators like musicians and not scientists, where harm is also loss of credit and not just revenue. Without explicit protections, scientists who input draft manuscripts or unfiled patents onto AI servers could face loss of proprietary rights.
Safeguarding Research: Experts recommend a strict protocol for scientists: file provisional patents before using AI, utilise APIs with guaranteed non-training clauses, and maintain dated offline notebooks to prove invention timelines. As such, IP attorneys believe that researchers must self-police what they share with AI until clearer rules emerge.
As usage of AI for research surges and institutions formalise ethical AI guidelines, how can researchers safely use AI without exposing unpublished work? Let’s find out…
From The Editor’s Desk
Moneyview’s Bumper Listing
The fintech unicorn made a stellar debut on the exchanges yesterday. The shares listed at ₹55.6 on the BSE, a premium of 64% over the issue price of ₹34. On the NSE, the stock listed at ₹55, marking a premium of nearly 62% over the issue price.
Moneyview’s ₹1,092 Cr IPO comprised a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹750 Cr and an OFS of up to 10.05 Cr shares. Moneyview’s market capitalisation at the time of listing stood at ₹9,788.6 Cr on the BSE.
Founded in 2014, Moneyview offers unsecured personal loans in partnership with banks and its in-house NBFC arm. The digital lender’s net profit zoomed 2.6X YoY to ₹173.8 Cr in Q1 FY27, while operating revenue jumped 50.2% YoY to ₹1,041.1 Cr.
Seeds Fincap Bags ₹100 Cr
The NBFC has raised $10.4 Mn in its Series B round led by the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation to scale its branch network, enhance risk-management systems, and expand into new markets.
Founded in 2021, Seeds Fincap uses a proprietary tech stack to offer loans of up to ₹1 Lakh to underserved individuals and small enterprises. The profitable startup claims to operate 164 branches, with total disbursements of approximately ₹620 Cr in FY26.
Indian lending tech startups are projected to generate over $250 Bn in revenue by 2030. The surge is expected to be driven by rising credit adoption, widespread internet adoption, co-lending models and AI-powered underwriting.
E2W Sales Bounce Back
Monthly electric two-wheeler registrations stood at 2.07 Lakh units in September, up 12.2% from 1.84 Lakh units registered in the previous month. Sales almost doubled from 1.05 Lakh units registered in the year-ago period.
Legacy auto giants – TVS Motor, Bajaj and Hero MotoCorp – together accounted for around 61% of sales in registrations, with all three recording MoM growth. Meanwhile, Ather’s registrations rose 4.9% MoM and Ola declined 3.5% month-on-month.
The growth could partly reflect the build-up to the festive season, when automakers and dealers typically step up inventory and promotional activity. Simultaneously, established manufacturers are also expanding their EV portfolios and distribution reach.
Fresh Bus’ FY26 Show
The electric intercity bus operator’s top line zoomed 2.4X YoY to ₹63.5 Cr in FY26 as it expanded its electric fleet and route network. The expansion also led to the startup’s net loss widening 33% YoY to ₹43.6 Cr in the fiscal under review.
Going forward, the ixigo-backed startup is now targeting a revenue of ₹180 Cr in FY27, while reducing its loss to around ₹25 Cr-₹30 Cr. Fresh Bus expects to turn profitable around June 2027 by doubling down on larger bus fleets.
Founded in 2019, Fresh Bus operates electric buses on intercity routes. The startup claims to operate 100 e-buses across 10 routes, primarily in South India. It intends to double this number to 200 by the end of FY27 and broaden its route options to 16.
Google Unveils New AI Model
Amid rising competition in AI, the big tech giant has now unveiled its new, most powerful model Gemini 4 Argon. The model will target long-running workloads across software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity.
Argon is initially being rolled out to a select group of “trusted cyber defenders”, with wider access planned for enterprises and consumers. The AI model will launch at an introductory price of $2 per a Mn input tokens and $10 per a Mn output tokens.
The rollout comes as Google, Anthropic and OpenAI are locked in an intense competition to deploy new AI models. Last month, OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, while Anthropic also recently launched Claude Opus 5.5.
UPI In September
The payments infrastructure processed 2,407 Cr transactions in September, down 1.8% from a record 2,451 Cr in the preceding month. The value of these transactions also fell 1.5% to ₹29.37 Lakh Cr from ₹29.82 Lakh Cr in August.
UPI processed an average of 80.2 Cr transactions per day in September, up from 791 Mn in August. The average daily transaction value also increased to ₹97,913 Cr from ₹96,205 Cr during the previous month.
The subdued numbers come amid ongoing debate over the future of UPI post the re-introduction of MDR, starting October 15. Under the framework, P2M UPI transactions above ₹2,000 will attract an MDR of 0.4%, capped at ₹300.
Inc42 Markets
Inc42 Startup Spotlight
How circuitEvolve Is Teaching AI To Design Analogue Chips
Analogue chip design still depends on thousands of simulation runs and manual parameter adjustments. This makes the process slow, expensive and difficult to scale. circuitEvolve is automating this repetitive workflow with its in-house AI layer.
AI For Chip Design: Founded in 2026, circuitEvolve is building AI-powered solutions that work alongside existing electronic design automation software. Once engineers input target specifications, the platform then searches through device configurations to find designs that balance performance, power and area.
The Closed Loop Stack: The startup’s flagship product, OPTIM, simulates circuit parameters, evaluates each candidate and verifies the results against target constraints. It continues iterating until the design converges. The system is simulator-agnostic and works across process-design kits and device libraries. The startup claims that OPTIM has been validated across more than 1,000 devices.
Riding India’s Chip Wave: The startup’s broader ambition is to automate the analogue design workflow from specification to layout-ready output. Future applications could include circuit understanding, schematic generation, simulation analysis and AI-guided design.
With the homegrown semiconductor market projected to become a $200 Bn opportunity by 2035, can circuitEvolve make AI an everyday co-pilot for analogue chip engineers?

OpenAI resmi memperkenalkan Dots, agen AI baru dirancang untuk membantu pengguna mengelola pekerjaan secara berkelanjutan. Berbeda dari chatbot yang menunggu instruksi setiap kali dipakai, OpenAI Dots dirancang untuk mengikuti sebuah pekerjaan sampai selesai.
Diumumkan dalam acara OpenAI DevDay 2026, Dots rencananya akan diluncurkan secara bertahap lewat ChatGPT di web, desktop, dan mobile untuk seluruh pengguna ChatGPT Pro.
Baca Juga: iBox Buka Pendaftaran Minat iPhone 18 Pro & iPhone Duo, Beri Voucher Potongan Harga Rp1,5 Juta
Karena tidak perlu menunggu instruksi setiap kali dipakai. OpenAI menjelaskan, pengguna cukup memberikan tujuan yang ingin dicapai. Setelah itu, Dots akan memantai progres, menentukan langkah berikutnya, dan menindaklanjuti saat ada perubahan, sehingga pengguna tidak perlu mengulang dari awal.
“Berikan dot sebuah tujuan dan sampaikan apa yang ingin Anda capai,” tulis OpenAI, sebagaimana dikutip dari keterangannya, Jumat (2/10/2026). “Dots kemudian dapat mengikuti perkembangan pekerjaan dan menentukan langkah berikutnya tanpa harus terus diberi instruksi.”
Apa itu Dots dari OpenAI?
OpenAI Dots
Dots adalah agen AI berbasis GPT-6 Astra. Pengguna cukup menyampaikan tujuan, lalu Dots mengurus kelanjutannya. Menurut lembar fakta OpenAI untuk media, Dots dapat memantau pekerjaan, memakai aplikasi yang terhubung, dan menghubungi pengguna jika ada hal yang butuh keputusan.
Setiap agen punya komputer cloud sendiri. Untuk menjalankan tugas, Dots memakai aplikasi yang terhubung, Codex, dan ChatGPT Work, mulai dari riset, analisis data, menyiapkan dokumen, sampai membantu membuat perangkat lunak.
OpenAI juga menyebut Dots dapat bekerja secara lebih proaktif. Agen AI ini dapat meninjau informasi dari aplikasi yang telah dihubungkan untuk menemukan pembaruan yang mungkin relevan bagi pengguna. 
Namun, OpenAI menegaskan terdapat sejumlah batasan, termasuk tidak dapat mengirim pesan kepada orang lain, mengubah konten di aplikasi pengguna, maupun mengendalikan komputer dan browser secara langsung.
Apa Bedanya OpenAI Dots dengan ChatGPT dan Codex?
OpenAI menempatkan Dots sebagai kategori produk tersendiri. ChatGPT dan Codex dipakai untuk berdiskusi, menggali ide, atau menyelesaikan pekerjaan selangkah demi selangkah. Dots dirancang untuk terus mengikuti satu pekerjaan sampai tuntas tanpa menunggu instruksi baru.
OpenAI Dots
Ada tiga perbedaan yang disebut OpenAI:
Dots dapat mempelajari preferensi kerja pengguna.
Dots mengingat keputusan sebelumnya, jadi percakapan tidak mulai dari nol.
Dots bisa menangani beberapa proyek sekaligus.
Bisa Membantu Developer hingga Kreator Konten
OpenAI menyiapkan sejumlah skenario penggunaan untuk berbagai profesi.
Bagi developer, Dots dapat membantu memindahkan aplikasi dari API lama ke API baru, membaca dokumentasi, membuat perubahan kode, hingga menyiapkan pull request untuk ditinjau.
Sementara untuk tim penjualan, agen AI ini dapat membantu memperbarui proposal sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan yang terus berubah.
Menariknya, OpenAI juga menyoroti penggunaan untuk kreator konten. Dots dapat membantu mengolah transkrip wawancara, menemukan bagian yang menarik untuk dijadikan klip, menyiapkan catatan acara, hingga membantu membuat konten media sosial.
Apa batasan Dots?
Dots bisa meninjau informasi dari aplikasi yang terhubung untuk mencari pembaruan yang relevan. Tapi OpenAI menetapkan batas. Dots tidak bisa mengirim pesan ke orang lain, tidak bisa mengubah konten di aplikasi pengguna, dan tidak bisa mengendalikan komputer maupun browser pengguna secara langsung [konfirmasi: apakah “komputer” di sini berarti perangkat pengguna, bukan komputer cloud milik agen.
Kapan OpenAI Dots Tersedia?
OpenAI mulai meluncurkan Dots secara bertahap melalui ChatGPT di web, desktop, dan perangkat seluler untuk pengguna Pro. Fitur ini juga tersedia bagi pelanggan Business Premium, sementara pengguna Enterprise dapat mengakses versi beta setelah diaktifkan oleh administrator ruang kerja.
Untuk mulai menggunakan Dots, pengguna perlu menghubungkan aplikasi yang ingin digunakan melalui ChatGPT versi desktop sebelum melanjutkan interaksi melalui perangkat lain.
PandAI untuk Keluarga, Cara OpenAI Bantu Orang Tua Dampingi Remaja
Communications Lead OpenAI Indonesia, Cipluk Carlita. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Perkembangan kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang cepat saat ini membuat banyak orang tua merasa diri mereka tertinggal dari anak-anak mereka. Namun menurut OpenAI, mendampingi remaja atau anak menggunakan AI tidak berarti orang tua harus selalu memiliki semua jawaban.
Pesan itu yang menjadi fokus peluncuran PandAI untuk Keluarga (Panduan Praktis AI untuk Keluarga), program baru OpenAI dirancang untuk membantu keluarga membangun kebiasaan penggunaan AI yang aman dan bertanggung jawab.
Communications Lead OpenAI Indonesia, Cipluk Carlita, mengatakan fenomena remaja yang lebih cepat memahami teknologi kini semakin umum terjadi.
Ia mengaku kerap menemukan anak-anaknya menggunakan aplikasi yang belum pernah ia coba sebelumnya.
“Sebagai orang tua, kita sebenarnya tidak harus mengetahui semuanya. Kalau generasi milenial tumbuh bersama teknologi, sekarang kita mendampingi anak-anak untuk tumbuh bersama teknologi,” kata Cipluk dalam sesi media di Jakarta, (30/9/2026).
Menurut Cipluk, peran orang tua bukan menjadi ahli teknologi, melainkan hadir sebagai pendamping yang dapat membantu anak memahami risiko dan peluang yang muncul dari perkembangan AI.
“Yang penting adalah mengetahui kapan harus mengingatkan mereka untuk berhati-hati, kapan perlu mengajak mereka berdiskusi, dan kapan kita bisa duduk bersama untuk mengeksplorasi sesuatu yang menarik,” paparnya.

items.author: Prasetyo Herfianto
items.content:
Mulai pekan ini, tanda-tanda kehadiran flagship terbaru Apple secara resmi ke Tanah Air seperti sudah mulai mendapatkan titik terang. Pasalnya, sejumlah peritel resmi produk Apple mulai menampilkan gambar baik iPhone 18 Pro Series hingga iPhone Duo. Termasuk iBox yang sudah membuka “daftar ketertarikan” sekaligus memberikan potongan khusus berupa voucher pembelian senilai hingga Rp1,5 juta.
Ya, iPhone 18 Pro Series memang sudah mulai dijual secara perdana setidaknya sejak pekan kemarin di sejumlah negara, termasuk China dan negara tetangga seperti Malaysia maupun Singapura. Sayangnya, Gizmo friends memerlukan waktu lebih lama untuk dapat membelinya secara resmi. Meski nampaknya tidak membutuhkan waktu lama, dengan bocoran tanggal pemesanan yang disebut bakal berlangsung pada bulan Oktober ini.
Hadir dalam dua bentuk alias form factor berbeda, Apple memutuskan untuk hadirkan iPhone 18 Pro Series terlebih dahulu. Sementara iPhone Duo masih menyusul beberapa pekan kemudian, menjadi smartphone lipat pertama Apple yang memang sudah dinanti-nanti oleh para penggemar smartphone Apple. Siap bersaing dengan flagship lipat lainnya termasuk dari rilisan Samsung hingga HUAWEI.
Baca juga: iPhone 18 Pro Series Sudah TKDN, Erajaya Bicara Soal Jadwal Rilis di Indonesia
Cara Mendapatkan Voucher iBox Value+ Untuk Potongan Harga iPhone 18 Pro & iPhone Duo
Sejak awal pekan ini, sejumlah peritel resmi produk Apple termasuk iBox Indonesia, sudah mulai memajang gambar render resmi dari masing-masing iPhone 18 Pro maupun iPhone Duo, baik pada situs resmi maupun media sosial resminya. Namun tidak hanya itu, iBox membuka pendaftaran ketertarikan yang memberikan benefit tambahan, yakni potongan harga khusus saat pembelian.
Melalui halaman khusus berikut ini, iBox menghadirkan sebuah sistem bernama “iBox Value+”. Sistemnya bisa dibilang khusus untuk konsumen yang memang sudah menantikan untuk membeli resmi, di mana Gizmo friends bisa menuliskan data diri, serta seri iPhone yang ingin dibeli nantinya ketika sudah dijual resmi. Setelah itu, pendaftar bisa membayarkan uang senilai Rp1 juta, yang nanti bisa dikonversi menjadi potongan harga Rp,5 juta untuk pembelian iPhone terbaru.
Voucher tersebut tersedia hingga 30 November 2026, dan setelah tanggal berakhir, nilai benefitnya bakal menjadi Rp1 juta saja, alias tidak mendapatkan potongan ekstra Rp500 ribu. iBox juga menyebutkan bila pendaftaran minat sekaligus pembelian voucher iBox Value+ masih belum menjamin kepastian mendapatkan produk. Dalam kata lain, bukan booking atau reservasi. Ketersediaan perangkat bakal tetap mengikuti stok serta ketentuan pre-order yang berlaku.
Menariknya, voucher iBox Value+ akan dapat digabungkan bersama promo lainnya saat periode pre-order sudah dimulai, seperti promo dengan metode pembayaran tertentu, hingga opsi cicilan. Tentunya informasi lebih lanjut terkait promo pre-order, baru akan diumumkan dalam beberapa waktu ke depan.
Pre-Order Dikabarkan Bakal Dimulai Pekan Depan
Sebelumnya, sempat muncul rumor di media sosial bila pre-order iPhone 18 Pro secara resmi di Indonesia, siap dimulai 9 Oktober mendatang, dengan ketersediaan perangkat pada 16 Oktober 2026. Sementara untuk iPhone Duo, bakal dapat dipesan mulai 23 Oktober, dengan tanggal ketersediaan perangkat menyusul 30 Oktober 2026.
Namun begitu, juga beredar rumor bila tanggal pre-order iPhone terbaru akan lebih cepat dari bocoran tanggal yang sudah disebutkan sebelumnya. Dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya, iPhone 18 Pro tampil dalam sejumlah opsi warna baru. Membawa chipset yang lebih kencang, daya tahan baterai paling lama dalam sejarah iPhone, serta kemampuan kamera lebih andal termasuk sensor utama yang mendukung variable aperture.
Sementara itu, iPhone Duo siap menjadi smartphone lipat pertama Apple. Dimensinya kurang lebih mirip dengan Galaxy Z Fold8, namun Apple menyesuaikan tampilan antarmukanya secara menyeluruh, agar dapat memaksimalkan baik porsi layar luar hingga layar lipat utamanya—yang hadir dengan permukaan nano texture serta membawa teknologi under-display camera. Dari keduanya, mana yang paling Gizmo friends nantikan kehadirannya secara resmi?

items.author: Emmanuel Okogba
items.content:
President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has failed to keep his promise to provide a constant electricity supply. He said at a business lunch in December 2022 that he shouldn’t be voted for a second term if he didn’t fix the electricity supply problem and end estimated billing in his first term. Although he modified that pledge by saying he should only be spared if he gave “adequate reasons” for failure, the only thing worse than his broken steady power supply promise is his appointment of paper tigers as power ministers. If CVs could guarantee a stable power supply, Tinubu’s first minister, Adebayo Adelabu, who served nearly three years, and the current one, Joseph Tegbe, his successor, would have turned Nigeria into a net exporter of power. Both, I’m told, have first-class credentials and know this power business like the back of their hands. By the time Adelabu finished serving, however, Tinubu had not only budgeted for a full-service 24/7 N17 billion solar power grid for the Presidential Villa, but the minister was also stumbling over millions of distressed Nigerians stranded in darkness, begging him to leave.
The cameo warden
When he finally yielded in April and showed up as a cameo traffic warden at a junction in Ibadan, Oyo State, it was clear that he was a waste at the power ministry. He should have been a warden – any kind of warden – all along. And then, in came Tegbe, whose credentials could light a bulb. A first-class graduate in Civil Engineering from Obafemi Awolowo University, he also holds a degree in Public Administration from the University of Birmingham. He has 35 years of professional experience, including senior leadership roles at KPMG. As for relevant power-sector experience, he played a central advisory role in reforming the sector at both the Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC) and the Nigerian Bulk Electricity Trading (NBET). If Nigeria ever needed a peg to square its power hole, Tegbe looked a fit. Except that his recent journey to the deep freezer of Nigerians suggests he might well not be the man after all. Like Adelabu, his predecessor, Tegbe’s obsession with our deep freezers is an icy joke. I’ll return to him.
Overcharged freezers
In April 2024, after the government established discriminatory payment bands for electricity consumers, Adelabu accused Nigerians of leaving their freezers frozen for days because they weren’t paying much for electricity. Adelabu’s headache, despite 16 total or partial grid collapses on his watch, was curbing electricity wastage – a legitimate concern that could be resolved automatically with the mass installation of prepaid metres. But Adelabu wasn’t bothered about meter availability, or didn’t think meters could adequately bill consumers who waste electricity on iced-over deep freezers. He was soon distracted by his ambition to become the governor of Oyo State. In his futile chase for political power, he became entangled with a prophet whom he accused of a N150 million cash-for-prophecy blackmail. What prophetic ritual couldn’t do for electricity, it obviously couldn’t do for political power. Nothing has significantly changed in the electricity sector – not supply, distribution, or even voltage – since then. Perhaps that is why Tegbe has come with his own fabulous and freezing fantasy tale.
A statement attributed to him almost implies that deep freezers are forming glacial ice in people’s homes due to an excess of electricity supply. According to Tegbe, he has been disturbed by calls “to slow down” by some Nigerians whose refrigerators are caked in ice and who, perhaps, would appreciate the lights being turned off, maybe for a few days or weeks.
Tegbe was so sold on his own delusion that about one month after his appointment, he said, “By 2027, by the grace of God, we will put a stop to this so-called subsidy in the power sector.”
With friends like Tegbe…
I don’t know how many ordinary folks have the privilege of access to Minister Tegbe’s phone number, or how many consider it a better patriotic duty to complain to the minister rather than walk into the kitchen and turn off those damned freezing chambers. Or, for that matter, if he knows the way around town to see for himself how solar panels have become an added weight on roofing sheets and how inverters and batteries are taking up space inside homes and offices. If he does, then he should be aware that he needs to speed up rather than “slow down” due to the environmental impact of having nearly every shop in Wuse Market – in the nation’s capital – running on petrol or diesel generators. Further afield, Tegbe must visit the industrial layouts of Sharada and Bompai in Kano; Kakuri in Kaduna; Oluyole in Ibadan; Bukuru in Jos; or Emene in Enugu, at least these few, to see how many factories are shut down or operating below installed capacity because of poor electricity supply.
Perhaps residents of those towns are even struggling to remember whether there’s a Ministry for Power and what the minister’s name might be. They can’t afford the luxury of a minister’s phone number, and so they can’t call him to report how the absence of power supply has slowed down their businesses and preoccupations.
Perhaps Tegbe is also blissfully unaware that ice-block making is a big business in itself and that ice-block suppliers invest in generators and cold compartments, without which many people on the streets of Nigerian cities won’t find a cold drink within the nearest perimeter of an endurance trek.
Post-cold-beer talk
Minister Tegbe and those who can call him are lucky. They may not be living in Nigeria after all, or may be insulated in some luxury mansions, totally oblivious to how many refrigerators are permanently disconnected simply because the available voltage is insufficient to power them. If the minister was not basking in a delusional fantasy – the sort of hyper-optimism often exhibited after one bottle too many of cold beer – then he should have started where it matters most: dissuade the Presidential Villa from budgeting N17 billion (about $12.5 million) to install the solar grid mentioned earlier. Just show them the freezing evidence.
Reality check
According to the NERC, the country has a total installed generation capacity of 13,625 megawatts (MW). But it currently generates and distributes roughly 4,000 to 5,000 MW of electricity to the national grid, some of which, reports indicate, cannot be discharged because of decrepit transmission infrastructure.
Using a population assumption of 200 million, Nigeria’s 13,625 megawatts of grid-connected installed generation capacity works out to just 68.13 watts per person, slightly more than the power required by a single 60-watt incandescent bulb. This is a theoretical capacity-to-population ratio, not the electricity each person actually receives; actual generation and electricity delivered to consumers are lower.
Is this the voltage level freezing the homes of those fortunate Nigerians who are complaining to the minister, or is there something else at play?
Freezers and campaign
Tegbe is nesting in a strait of imagination, oblivious to the continuous power outages and grid collapses that have forced many homes and businesses to emulate Aso Rock by investing in alternative energy sources and getting off the national grid. He’s not in touch with reality at all! But it’s the season of campaigns – a time when many storms, even freezing blasts, are brewed in the teacups of politicians.
Tinubu should tell his minister that this particular line is a brazen lie that adds to the annoyance of a broken promise.
*Ishiekwene is the Editor-in-Chief of LEADERSHIP and author of the book Writing for Media and Monetising It.

items.content:
Slinger Francisco, better known as Mighty Sparrow, the “Calypso King of the World”, flew away on September 27, 2026. He was ninety.
Calypso music was invented in the seventeenth century by African slaves in Trinidad who had mainly been taken from the Ibibio, Efik and Igbo peoples in present-day Nigeria and Congo. It is generally accepted that the name calypso originated from the Efik word “kaiso” (ka isu), which means “go on!”, and the Ibibio words “kaa iso”, meaning “continue, go on”. They were common words used by the slaves to urge somebody to go on or meet a challenge. Eventually, the word “cariso” emerged among Trinidadians. It meant “old-time” calypsos. Calypso was not just music, but also a coded means of communication from which the colonial masters were excluded. It spread news among the enslaved, made fun of slave owners, advanced social commentary and allowed verbal competition, including insulting lyrics.
It was initially sung in French Creole because the masters who brought the slaves to the Trinidadian sugar plantations were French planters. But it was a Spanish colony which changed hands between the Courlanders from present-day Latvia, the Dutch, French and British. The latter fully took over the territory following ‘The Treaty of Paris’, signed on May 30, 1814. This is how Calypso was eventually rendered more in English.
Calypso evolved with varied instruments, including guitar, congas, trombone, double bass, saxophone, piano and maraca. It was street music that became the famous Trinidad Carnival, which promoted competition, especially after the 1834 abolition of slavery. The best-known calypso musicians adopted names that sounded bombastic, such as Roaring Lion; historical, like Attila the Hun; and, given British colonialism, royal titles like Duke and Lord. This might have given rise to the common name or title ‘Lord’, such as Lord Invader, Lord Melody, Lord Pretender, Lord Creator, Lord Brynner and, of course, Lord Kitchner, referred to as the “Grandmaster of Calypso”.
Mighty Sparrow explained how he earned his new name: “When I started singing, the bands were still using acoustic instruments and the singers would stand flat-footed, making a point or accusing someone in the crowd with the pointing of a finger, but mostly they stood motionless. When I sing, I get excited and move around, much like James Brown, and this was new to them. The older singers said, ‘Why don’t you just sing instead of moving around like a little sparrow?’ It was said as a joke, but the name stuck.” Later, he changed his name from Little Sparrow to Mighty Sparrow.
His first public performance was the song “The Parrot and the Monkey” in 1954. The following year, he recorded “Missing Baby (Ruby)”, “High Cost of Living” and “Race Track”. Sparrow had been born a Grenadian, but at the age of one, his mother moved him to Trinidad and Tobago, T&T. His music explored the wide themes of calypso music. In 1956, he celebrated the departure of United States troops from T&T with his famous song ‘Jean and Dinah’ or “Yankees Gone”. In it, he accused them of promoting prostitution. When T&T became independent on August 31, 1962, he released a song, ‘Our Model Nation’. He sang: “The whole population of our little nation Is not a lot But oh! what a mixture of races and culture That’s what we’ve got Still no major indifference Of race, color, religion or finance It’s amazing to you I’m sure.”
But there was a political crisis in the new nation, and Mighty Sparrow, in his album ‘Sparrow the Conqueror’, defended the Government of Dr. Eric Williams. He sang that the actions of the opposition were senseless: “Come on, what is wrong with this island Poor Dr. Williams Come on, I said what’s wrong with this island Poor Dr. Williams Everybody doing what they like Striking when they want to strike It appears that nobody cares About the island economy I tell you.”
He crooned that what was going on was anarchism: “No gas today, no phone tomorrow What next I don’t know No drain digging, no rubbish cleaning Only corbeaux working The island as you see suffering politically Because the present Government have some stupid opponent Oh Lord man they ignorant Because the present Government have some stupid opponent Not one is intelligent Some of them, them opposing So much crime they commit Some again have no education Is them does make the confusion Anything at all the Premier say They always standing in the way And like they suffering from a mental block Talking one set of sewerage talk I tell you.”
Mighty Sparrow was so fanatical in his support of the Williams administration, and so angry with those opposed to it, that he recommended the death penalty for the opposition: “The Premier cannot make a suggestion Without a big objection And some of them way want to object Really should have a rope ‘round they neck.”
But Sparrow eventually fell out with the Williams administration. Part of his criticism is captured in the song “No, Doctor, No”. Pan-Africanist Kwame Nkrumah strove in the late 1950s not just to mould Africa into a single country but also to strive for wider African-Diaspora unity. But it appeared the Caribbean was moving faster as it, in 1958, established the West Indies Federation, made up of ten British colonies, to jointly secure independence and build a united region with its capital in T&T. But disagreements over issues like leadership, power distribution and the choice of a capital surfaced. Jamaica sounded the death knell by holding a referendum in 1962, resulting in its exit and the collapse of the federation.
Sparrow was inconsolable. In a song that year titled ‘Federation’, he sang: “Whether you’re a damn Trinidadian (We are as one!) If they say you’re a smart Barbadian (We are as one!) Get away from me you crazy Grenadian (We are as one!) I don’t care if you’re a bad Jamaican (We are as one!) Let us join together and love one another (We are as one!) If you’re born in New York and your parents are West Indian (We are as one!)”
He had long stays in Britain and the US. In 1977, he went to West Africa on a music tour during which he was given a Yoruba chieftaincy, Omowale (the child has returned home) of Ikoyi. Sparrow settled in the US and, in 2008, released “Barack the Magnificent” in support of Barack Obama’s race to the White House. In all, he had over 280 songs captured in more than seventy albums, straddling varied aspects of life, from love and politics to gospel. For over seven decades, Mighty Sparrow flew around the world, pollinating generations. Now, he has flown out into eternity.
The post Calypso: Enslaved African gift and its Mighty Sparrow, by Owei Lakemfa appeared first on Vanguard News.

items.content:
NOT a few Nigerians, especially me, expected that there would be something to hold on to when the President made his speech commemorating our National Day, October 1, yesterday morning. As a newspaperman, I read the message more than three times, looking for that strand of a message that could give hope that at the end of the tunnel in which we have been thrown, there would be a glimmer of light, signalling hope that things would begin a turnaround for the better.
Alas, like so many other countrymen and women, numbering in scores of millions, it was not to be as the president opted to grandstand on what he thinks are achievements. The same old chorus, now sounding like a broken record, was recited to us — necessity of reforms, NELFUND, Credicorp, and all that. There was no talk about how we would soon pay less for petrol, diesel, cooking gas, or electricity.
Let me backtrack a bit. When Nigeria was Nigeria, we eagerly looked forward to October 1. As schoolchildren in the glorious 60s and 70s, every October 1, our teachers told us to come to school with our plates and spoons. Everyone of us got a plate of rice and a chunky piece of meat, with a bottle of mineral drink to drown it in. Government worked so well in those days that the headmasters of primary schools got the funds with which to prepare these meals for their pupils well ahead of time. And it was a time when there was nothing like bank transfers, internet banking. The POS operator was an alien figure. Yet, things worked. If it were now, the funds will never get to the school headmasters, and the children would never get any food.
That time too, was when Nigeria was arguably the most secure country in the world, compared to what now obtains. A little over 50 years ago, in April 1976, I was in Class III in secondary school. Our Geography teacher, Mr Bayo Ogunnupe, decided to organise an excursion. That excursion took us to Kainji Dam in today’s Niger State. Each of us paid 30 kobo — three 10 kobo coins for the trip, from our school, Remo Divisional High School in Sagamu, Ogun State. We went safely and returned safely, four days after we set out. If it were now, we would probably have been kidnapped, taken hostage, and ransom demanded for our return. In any case, no teacher would dream of such an excursion today, and no parent would allow his/her child/ward to participate. That is how bad things have turned out.
And talking about how bad things have turned out, one had hoped that the president would tell us a little of the good things he has done or plans to do to make things better. In particular, I expected a response to the threat of a warning strike by the  Joint National Public Service Negotiating Council, JNPSNC. The JPNSC is made up of eight public sector unions — the Nigerian Civil Service Union, NCSU; Medical and Health Workers Union, M&HWU; Association of Senior Civil Servants of Nigeria, ASCSN; and National Association of Nigerian Nurses and Midwives, NANNM.
Others are the Amalgamated Union of Public Corporations, Civil Service Technical and Recreational Employees, AUPCTRE; Nigeria Union of Public Service, Reportorial, Secretarial, Data Processors and Allied Workers, NUPSRAW; National Union of Printing, Publishing and Paper Products Workers, NUPPPPROW; and the National Union of Agriculture and Allied Employees, NUAEE. On September 21, the public servants wrote to the president, beseeching him to find ways to bring the price of petrol down to N500, and also demanded a wage award, and commencement of negotiations for a new minimum national wage.
I support the demands of the unions, because it might make government really take action that will benefit all of us, including the insensitive ones in the corridors of power. If somehow petrol can be made to sell for N500, that would be a huge relief to all of us, rich or poor. If a new national minimum wage is negotiated, it means more cash in the bank accounts of workers and increased purchasing power, which will translate to reduced industrial inventory and other benefits to the economy. But there was no word from the president on this issue. Maybe because he had been away from the country in the last three weeks. But if it was really the working vacation we were told it was, it means the president was getting information about the things that needed his attention on a daily basis. Or the threat of strike by public servants did not need the attention of the president? In all, the optics of government’s performance, as it relates to the welfare of the governed, is rather disppointing. The disappointment is even deeper when you consider that we are in election season, a period when normal politicians should be doing anything within their power to please the people. Not so here. The contempt that those in government have for those they are governing is so thick and heavy one can almost feel it the way a porter feels the weight of a load. If not, roads would not remain potholed for months and streets get clogged with garbage for months as is the case in Lagos. Is it because these people know they will be back in office after next year’s elections, whether we vote or not? If that, why not some eye service, which will be better than no service? TGIF.
